name: Bramblet · Gremlet #36
description:
A badger cub that digs tunnels under the hedgerow and invites everyone over.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Bramblet in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
